{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wolf Den''' was located in the mountains surrounding the [[Dawn Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. It was home to outcast wolves from the [[Icewolf|icewolves]] that lived in the [[Caves of Light and Shadow]].
